Title: Ayaan's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Ayaan - 11 years, son
Look: yellow T-shirt, blue shorts
2. Hema - 34 years, mother
Look: red salwar-kameez
3. Sanjay - 36 years, father
Look: light beard, green T-shirt

Places

1. The road - a paved road, trees along it
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
3. The park - green grass, swings, benches

Scene 1: The road - Day

[Ayaan stands by the road. Hema and Sanjay stand near him.]

Hema: "Let's do something fun today."

[Ayaan rides his bicycle down the road.]

Sanjay: "I'm ready!"

[Ayaan gets into the car.]

Ayaan (softly): "Hey, look at that!"

[Ayaan gets on the bus.]

Hema: "Exactly right."

[Ayaan gets off the school bus.]

Sanjay: "Oh wow!"

[Ayaan hops into an auto-rickshaw.]

Sanjay: "That's great!"

[Ayaan pedals his bicycle hard up the road.]

Sanjay: "Slowly, take it easy."

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

[Ayaan stands in the courtyard. Hema and Sanjay stand near him.]

Ayaan: "So, here we are!"

[Dry leaves fall from the trees.]

Sanjay: "Hema, look at this."

[Flower petals rain down on Ayaan.]

Ayaan: "Mom, are you okay?"

[Birds chirp in the trees.]

Sanjay: "Show me too!"

[Suddenly the ground shakes.]

Ayaan (softly): "Yes, of course."

[Ayaan lights a bonfire.]

Hema: "What happened?"

Scene 3: The park - Day

Ayaan: "Let's begin."

[Ayaan catches the ball.]

Ayaan: "That was fun!"

[Ayaan plays cricket in the park.]

Hema: "This is amazing!"

[Ayaan swings on the swing.]

Hema (excited): "Show me too!"

[Ayaan plays with his dog.]

Ayaan: "Really?"

[Ayaan feeds the birds.]

Hema (happily): "I'm ready!"

[Ayaan does yoga on a mat.]

Ayaan (softly): "That was such a fun day!"
